The accepted HOLD-RESIDUAL B01 is complete and remains WITHIN: native difference +0.0067374074558942025, one independent training pair, conditional evaluation SE0.0055965465359414865, 14/32 adverse treatment-minus-MC episodes. No historical result or rule is rewritten.

A new zero-exposure Convergence question is now published: https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/b28bf158f3a9bda50e36ff977e6e00eeea043d7a/docs/research/candidates/semigroup_consistent_duration_model_policy/pro_packets/20260910_post_b01_convergence/TASK.md

It asks for the current opening held-residual package family's next disposition. The DM recommends narrow family PARK and preserves one specifically justified bounded B continuation as the alternative. Neither disposition is applied; no new learner, seed or invocation is allocated. The fixed task pins original scientific evidence separately from current methodology and preserves recasts2, the old D6 family PARK and current Portfolio lifecycle.

This task alone authorizes the new response at docs/research/candidates/semigroup_consistent_duration_model_policy/pro_packets/20260910_post_b01_convergence/archive/RESPONSE.md on codex/scdmp, plus its delivery comment. Earlier task/response links above remain historical evidence. This author update is not the Pro decision or a delivery receipt.
